expanse27_nathan_hale.name: UNN Nathan Hale — Leonidas-class
expanse27_nathan_hale.description: An older UNN battleship: two slow medium railgun turrets, twelve defensive batteries and a four-torpedo volley. Durable but slow; narrow rail tracking rewards flanking.
expanse27_nathan_hale.pdc.name: UNN defensive cannon battery
expanse27_nathan_hale.rail.name: UNN medium railgun
expanse27_nathan_hale_magazine.name: UNN light torpedo magazine
expanse27_nathan_hale_magazine.descripti: 4 UNN light torpedoes every 10 seconds while an eligible enemy is available. 24-round magazine; reloads 120 seconds after the last volley. Torpedoes expire after 30 seconds.
expanse27_munroe.name: UNN Munroe-class cruiser
expanse27_munroe.description: A detailed UNN line cruiser with eight defensive batteries, a fixed forward keel railgun and six-torpedo volleys. Thick armor favors formation combat; the keel gun requires the ship to face its target.
expanse27_munroe.pdc.name: UNN defensive cannon battery
expanse27_munroe.rail.name: UNN keel railgun
expanse27_munroe_magazine.name: UNN light torpedo magazine
expanse27_munroe_magazine.description: 6 UNN light torpedoes every 12 seconds while an eligible enemy is available. 36-round magazine; reloads 120 seconds after the last volley. Torpedoes expire after 30 seconds.
